pages.name: Graphics
pages.contract: Initial shapes, clipping, patterns and text; leaving Palettes and returning restores the original content.

pages.name: Controls
pages.contract: Button, checkbox and scrollbar each set their State menu checkmark.

pages.name: Windows
pages.contract: Three-window stack, activation, title-bar drag, resize, overlap hit test and predecessor promotion after each close.

pages.name: Drawing & 3D Bevels
pages.contract: QuickDraw shapes and images; visible PPC QuickDraw 3D traversal, silhouette and interior lighting; labelled 68K fallback.

pages.name: Game Preferences
pages.contract: Controls update the active profile and hierarchical menu marks; Difficulty, Sound and Renderer menu selections update controls; Reset restores defaults.

pages.name: Dialogs & Alerts
pages.contract: Resource-backed modal opens, checkbox changes, OK accepts; About alert opens and dismisses; status records completion.

pages.name: TextEdit
pages.contract: Mouse selection, copy/private scrap, cut, paste, typing over selection, reset and paragraph justification agree with native readouts.

pages.name: Palettes
pages.contract: Indexed transfers preserve their color contracts; animation recolors indexed pixels and leaves direct devices unchanged; menu-bar drag restores Graphics.

pages.name: Lists & Inventory
pages.contract: Selection/readback, mutation, scrolling, resizing, activation and hidden-scrollbar lifetime.

pages.name: Sound & Channels
pages.contract: Audible SysBeep; complete full/75%/50% native resource PCM; queued volume, flush, quiet, completion callback and disposal.

pages.name: Styled Text & Fonts
pages.contract: Multistyled text and Font Manager/measurement readouts render with the documented native presentation differences.

pages.name: Standard File
pages.contract: Filtered Open navigates to and accepts TEXT; legacy Open cancels; modern Save edits/accepts then creates/deletes its file; legacy Save cancels.

pages.name: Resource Browser
pages.contract: Deferred DATA enumeration, stable refresh, named loading, handle release and identical reload; DATA/MENU/WIND counts and lifecycle readouts.

pages.name: Sprites, Masks & Scrolling
pages.contract: First visit already has intact masks and verified pixel/region checks; animation changes both sprites; ScrollRect translates the existing raster 24 pixels; Reset restores initial scene.

pages.name: Events & Cursors
pages.contract: Activation/update lifecycle, held Button/StillDown/WaitMouseUp, PostEvent/peek/take, Shift and GetKeys, cursor selection and balanced hide/show.

pages.name: Popup & Dropdown Lists
pages.contract: Resource and programmatic controls, disabled/separator cancellation, scroll to item 36, final item 4, and restored closed titles.
